faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.what_a: A deposit-backed event check-in platform. Attendees put down a deposit, show up, get scanned, and get the whole deposit back, plus a compressed NFT badge on Solana.
faq.wallet_q: Do attendees need a crypto wallet?
faq.wallet_a: No. Checking in and paying by PromptPay work on any phone. A wallet is only needed to pay a USDC deposit or to claim the NFT badge.
faq.deposit_a: Organizers set a deposit amount (e.g., 500 THB). PromptPay deposits are off-chain: the organizer transfers it back {{ refund_window }}. If you can't make it, tell the organizer before the cut-off; the organizer sets the rule. USDC deposits sit in a Solana escrow (on devnet for now) and you claim them back after the event ends.
faq.crypto_q: Is it only for crypto events?
faq.crypto_a: It works for any event — meetups, workshops, conferences, hackathons. The blockchain part runs behind the scenes; attendees don't need to know anything about crypto.
faq.account_q: Why do I need to sign in?
faq.account_a: A deposit is real money, so every registration belongs to a verified account. Sign in with Google or a Solana wallet; there is no guest registration.
faq.ticket_a: Sign in on the home page. Under Your events, tap Show ticket for the QR code, or open the full ticket. The QR appears once your deposit is verified; show it at the entrance and staff scan it in a couple of seconds.
faq.claim_q: When can I claim my badge?
faq.claim_a: After staff check you in. Your ticket then leads to the claim page. The claim link works for a limited time after check-in, so claim it soon.
faq.cancel_a: There is no cancel button yet. Tell the organizer, who can cancel your registration. What happens to a PromptPay deposit is in the deposit answer above.
faq.privacy_q: What do you do with my data?
faq.privacy_a: Only what running the event needs. You can stop marketing emails or ask for deletion yourself.
faq.org_create_q: How do I host an event?
faq.org_create_a: Organizer access is by invitation for now: join the waitlist on the home page and we will reach out. After that you create the event, its deposit and its registration form in the admin.
faq.org_capacity_a: Set separate in-person and online caps. The event page shows the seats left and says full when none are left.
faq.org_checkin_q: How does check-in work at the door?
faq.org_checkin_a: Your staff open the scanner on any phone, no app needed, and scan each ticket's QR code. Walk-ins can be registered on the spot, and a live dashboard shows arrivals.
faq.org_settle_a: PromptPay deposits reach you off-chain; you return them {{ refund_window }}, or the attendee keeps them as credit for a next event. USDC deposits stay in the Solana escrow (on devnet for now) until the attendee claims them back.
